name: gpio_regs
desc: General purpose I/O: direction, output with atomic set / clear / toggle, synchronised inputs, edge interrupts.

registers.name: OUT
registers.desc: output register: reads the pin output values, a write sets them all

registers.name: DIR
registers.desc: direction per pin, 1 = output (0 = input, pad high-Z)

registers.name: INT_EN
registers.desc: interrupt enable per pin (INT_STATUS bits that raise irq_o)

registers.name: RISE_EN
registers.desc: a rising edge of the pin sets INT_STATUS

registers.name: FALL_EN
registers.desc: a falling edge of the pin sets INT_STATUS

registers.name: INT_STATUS
registers.desc: edges seen per pin; write 1 to clear
